scope: First bounded read-only Virtual_READ vs KMBUS_RAM_READ 0x41 correlation on local WB2A / VDensHO1 / 20C2.
live_results: All 7 ordinary Virtual_READ requests succeeded; all 7 KMBUS_RAM_READ 0x41 requests produced client-side timeout, including the previously verified 0x00F8/8 positive control.
conclusion: The failed 0x41 correlation run was caused by using VS2/P300 generic requests against a production splitter intentionally running permanent VS1/KW. No conclusion about KMBUS_RAM_READ address semantics can be drawn from those timeouts.

control_assessment.reason: The known-positive 0x41 0x00F8/8 request timed out even though the same request had previously returned 20c2000300000103. Therefore this run cannot classify the tested address mappings.
control_assessment.normal_transport: All seven ordinary Virtual_READ requests succeeded.
control_assessment.important_boundary: optolink-debug reports timeout after filtering MQTT responses by requested address. A timeout does not prove that the controller emitted no response; an unmatched-address error/response could have been discarded by the helper.

next_step.action: Run KMBUS_RAM_READ only in a deliberately bounded temporary P300/VS2 maintenance window: stop the single-owner VS1 splitter (and Party service if active), initialize P300 explicitly, perform read-only 0x01 control + 0x41 reads, close serial, then restore permanent VS1 services and verify P06/GFA polling.

transport_diagnostic_2208.journal_observation: Splitter remained active and continued normal receive traffic; supplied tail did not expose an accepted generic-request response.
interpretation: The failure is not specific to KMBUS_RAM_READ because generic function 0x01 also times out.

In current upstream optolink-splitter source, read_datapoint_ext(0x00F8,8) and do_request(function=0x01,address=0x00F8,length=8,data='',protid=0x00) construct the same VS2 request bytes: 41 05 00 01 00 F8 08 06.
Therefore, if the live do_request() branch is actually executed, the controller should see the same request as the successful ordinary read.

The strongest current hypothesis is a live-install command-dispatch/version mismatch: the deployed requests_util.py may not contain/execute the request/req branch, or the response may be published in a form filtered by optolink-debug.
This must be verified on the live host before any further KM-BUS semantic testing.
next_read_only_tests: Inspect the live /opt/optolink/requests_util.py for the request/req branch and identify the actual imported module path.
Use raw;4105000100F80806 as a byte-identical Virtual_READ control that bypasses the request command dispatcher.
Use raw;4105004100F80846 as the byte-level KMBUS_RAM_READ 0x41 control.
Only resume address correlation after one of the raw/generic 0x41 controls succeeds.
corrected_interpretation: The generic request timeouts were expected under permanent VS1 because vs12_adapter.do_request() explicitly raises NotImplementedError: request command not supported with VS1/KW, use raw instead.
The journal confirms exactly this for both request;0x01 and request;0x41.
The raw P300 frames also timed out because raw sends bytes directly into the currently active VS1/KW session; it does not switch the appliance/session into P300/VS2.
Therefore the prior hypothesis of a broken/old request dispatcher was incorrect.
The earlier locally successful 0x41 KMBUS_RAM_READ result must have been obtained while the splitter/device was in VS2/P300 context, before permanent VS1 production activation.

production_transport_context.reason: Permanent VS1 was activated earlier on 2026-09-24 to support stable mixed F7 Virtual_READ + 6B GFA_READ production polling, including blower speed P06.
production_transport_context.consequence: VS2/P300 generic request function codes such as 0x41 cannot be issued through the live splitter's request/do_request path while VS1 is active.

invalidated_conclusions: Do not interpret request;0x01 timeout as evidence of a dispatcher/version mismatch.
Do not use P300 raw frames 41 05 ... inside the live persistent VS1/KW session.
